name: Tempering, Greater
body:
School transmutation; Level sorcerer/wizard 5, vanguard 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 minute
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target object whose volume is up to 10 cu. ft./level
Duration instantaneous and permanent
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless, object); Spell Resistance yes (harmless, object)

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as tempering, except it initially heals the object for 1d6 hit points per caster level (max 15d6), and the increase to the objects hardness is permanent (along with the protection against rust and decay).
